title: Top Hoodies for Cold Days (2026)
summary: Gear Patrol and Men's Health both recommend the Flint and Tinder 10-Year Pullover, Champion Reverse Weave, Reigning Champ Midweight Terry and Everlane ReTrack, with Flint and Tinder as Gear Patrol's best overall hoodie.
method: Only hoodies that both guides recommend made this list. Gear Patrol's men's hoodie guide (published and last updated March 2024) tested dozens of hoodies as base layers, mid-layers and on their own. Men's Health says its style editors have worn over 50 hoodies since 2020 for at least two weeks each. Four hoodies appear in both: Flint and Tinder, Champion, Reigning Champ and Everlane. The Men's Health copy we read has no visible update date.
assumptions: The Gear Patrol guide is from 2024, so its prices and colors may have changed, and we quote the price each source showed instead of today's price. Some of these brands sell mainly on their own sites, so the Amazon link may open a search that does not list the exact hoodie. Neither source is a lab test of warmth, so for cold days we only repeat what they say about fabric weight and fit.

products.name: Flint and Tinder 10-Year Pullover Hoodie
why: Gear Patrol picks it as its best overall hoodie. It uses hefty 23-ounce fleece with a double-lined hood and a reinforced kangaroo pocket, and the brand will repair it if it rips or wears out within ten years.
Gear Patrol says the raglan sleeves give plenty of mobility. Men's Health also lists it among its tested favorites and calls it a durable heavyweight with a flattering fit and soft feel.
specs: 70% cotton, 30% polyester fleece, classic fit, made in the USA (Gear Patrol)
10-year guarantee against rips and wear (Gear Patrol, Men's Health)
Both sources showed $118 at Huckberry; check the current price
pros: Raglan sleeves allow plenty of movement
cons: Gear Patrol says the polyester is noticeable against the skin
Gear Patrol says many users find it runs small
products.best_for: Anyone who wants one heavy, long-lasting hoodie for cold days

products.name: Champion Reverse Weave Hoodie
why: Gear Patrol names it the best reverse weave hoodie and calls it a great starter hoodie. Its reverse weave fabric is built not to shrink in the wash.

Men's Health says the patented reverse weave process extends the life of the hoodie and reduces shrinking. Its thick cotton-blend build keeps you warm in shoulder season without a jacket, and the loose fit leaves room for layers.

pros: Room to layer over a shirt
cons: Gear Patrol notes two logos that draw attention

Men's Health says the thick build may be too hot for summer

tips.title: How to choose
items: Check the fabric on the tag.
Gear Patrol says the material listed on the tag, such as French terry or fleece-back, does more than anything else to decide a hoodie's look, feel and longevity.
Match the weight to the weather.
Men's Health says lightweight hoodies suit indoors and heavyweight ones suit outdoors, and it warns that Champion's thick build may be too hot for summer.
Pick the fit you will actually wear.
Men's Health lists regular, slim and relaxed fits. Gear Patrol says to size up on the slim Reigning Champ if you like a boxy cut, and that Flint and Tinder runs small for many users.
Both guides credit Champion's reverse weave with reducing shrinkage, which matters if you wash your hoodie often.

faq: What is the best hoodie overall?
Gear Patrol picks the Flint and Tinder 10-Year Pullover as its best overall hoodie, and Men's Health also lists it among the hoodies it tested and liked.
What is the best cheap hoodie?

Of the four here, Champion Reverse Weave is the lowest priced at $65 to $70 in the two sources. Gear Patrol also names the Russell Athletic Pullover Fleece Hoodie as its budget pick at $23.28 on Amazon when it last updated the guide in March 2024.
Which hoodie is best for a slim fit?

Gear Patrol picks the Reigning Champ Midweight Terry Pullover as its best slim-fit hoodie. Men's Health says its testers found it flattering on all body types, while Gear Patrol warns that the slim cut is not for every body.
Will a hoodie shrink in the wash?

Both guides say Champion's reverse weave is made to resist shrinking. Gear Patrol also says Knickerbocker knits its fabric horizontally to prevent shrinkage, but that hoodie is not in Men's Health's list.
